summary.text: Veronica E. Hinton-authored OPM materials state that OPM is implementing requirements of the AI in Government Act of 2020 and issued AI classification and talent acquisition guidance intended to help agencies hire and retain a highly skilled AI workforce. A December 2025 memo states that OPM granted governmentwide direct-hire authority for certain information technology, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and other technical positions and says attracting and retaining such talent is essential to safeguarding Federal systems and modernizing operations. The materials also describe an OPM AI job analysis survey to validate AI competencies and guidance supporting governmentwide skills-based hiring for AI, data, and technology talent in compliance with Executive Order 14110. The AI classification guidance discusses using “Artificial Intelligence or AI” as a parenthetical title for occupational series performing AI work the majority of the time and describes AI as enhancing Federal employees’ capabilities and augmenting work.
